claims: The Pokémon GO Scorbunny Community Day takes place on Saturday, March 14, 2026.
The Pokémon GO Scorbunny Community Day takes place from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time.
Scorbunny will appear more frequently in the wild.
Shiny versions of Scorbunny are debuting.
Evolving Raboot into Cinderace during the event or up to four hours after gains the Charged Attack Blast Burn.
Blast Burn has 120 power in Trainer Battles.
Blast Burn has 110 power in raids.
Cinderace will learn the charged attack Pyro Ball.
Shiny Scorbunny, Raboot, and Cinderace are appearing for the first time.
The event features a 1/4 Hatch Distance bonus.
The event features 2x Candy for catching.
The event features 2x chance for Trainers level 31+ to receive Candy XL.
A $1.99 research story "Scorbunny Community Day" will be available.
The "Scorbunny Community Day" research story offers extra encounters.
The "Scorbunny Community Day" research story offers encounters with special backgrounds.
Incense and Lure Modules will last for three hours.
125 Scorbunny Candy are required for evolution (25 to Raboot, 100 to Cinderace).
